tools.name: assess_formation
tools.description: Get a formation assessment and its assessmentId from non-sensitive business facts, free. Stores the assessment for a later application. Use when the customer wants to form a US company.

tools.name: prepare_application
tools.description: Get a private claimUrl for the customer to review and pay, free to prepare. Stores a provisional application. Use the qualifying assessmentId, the intended recipient email and a stable operationId to recover the same application after a lost reply.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Get the application stage and next action using an owner-issued, expiring status grant. Requires applicationId and AgentGrant; the grant is scoped to that application. Returns redacted status.

tools.name: get_formation_contract
tools.description: Get the current OpenAPI document with  input fields and response schemas for formation assessment, application preparation and status.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: Get filing fees, annual costs and registered-agent requirements for Wyoming, Delaware, New Mexico, Florida, Texas and California, with government sources and retrieval dates.

tools.name: explain_ein_route
tools.description: Get IRS EIN application channels for the applicant's SSN or ITIN status and principal business location, plus EIN.LLC's qualifying 2 to 3 business day delivery route.

tools.name: get_compliance_deadlines
tools.description: Get dated filing obligations for the supplied company facts, with government sources. Form 5472 depends on entity status and reportable transactions; missing facts return a review-needed result. The calendar is available through the HTTP contract.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_application, get_compliance_deadlines · Private data: prepare_application, get_formation_contract · Public sink: prepare_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_application, get_compliance_deadlines · Private data: prepare_application, get_formation_contract · Public sink: prepare_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assess_formation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Assess formation need without checkout. Anonymous. An SSN-shaped or ITIN-shaped field is refused and nothing is stored." → after: "Get a formation assessment and its assessmentId from non-sensitive business facts, free. Stores the assessment for a later application. Use when the customer wants to form a US company."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
